text: I recently made the switch to Dr. Philip Lieberman, and the experience has been night and day compared with a traditional primary care practice. During our initial appointment alone, Dr. Lieberman spent two hours with me, taking the time to get to know me as a person and fully understand my medical history, habits, goals, and concerns. This is what primary care medicine should be!

Dr. Lieberman is the way a doctor should be. He spent significant amount of time with me, not only around my concerns about a stroke, but also my mental and nutritional well-being. As a Hospice chaplain who works with numerous doctors and nurses, I can honestly say I’ve never seen anything like this. I wish I switched sooner.

Switching over to Dr. Lieberman this past year has been a game changer. He is always available and so quick to respond. Dr. Lieberman makes sure you have all the info needed when you leave a visit. He has really opened my eyes to many things pertaining to my health.

I’ve been a patient of Dr. Landi’s for sometime now and I’m excited that he’s transitioning to direct primary care! He always takes time to listen and thoroughly explain treatment options and provide truly personalized care! If you’re looking for a family medicine doctor who focuses on preventative care, wellness and building long-term relationships, I highly recommend Dr. Landi.

Dr. Bigley has been wonderful as our daughter’s doctor, he takes as much time as you need, never rushing through an appointment. He listens deeply, asks thoughtful questions, and makes sure you leave feeling heard, understood and everything you came in to discuss has been covered!

I have followed Dr. Landi from his residency at Christiana, then to Main Line, and now to his direct primary care practice with Forward Family Medicine. He is one of the few doctors I have met with that truly listens to my concerns, and takes the time to research and come up with solutions that are personalized to my needs and goals. I am really excited to see that he has menopause certification.

OK, I’m 81 years young with a couple medical issues. But Dr Bigley brings back memories from my childhood — house calls! He takes the time to listen and amazingly, his first recommendation does not include a prescription pad. And, the phone answers and the next appointment available is not next month.

My kids have Dr. Lieberman as their doctor and we truly couldn’t be happier. Dr. Lieberman is very meticulous when it comes to patient history and how his patients are doing. I recommend him to anyone who is looking for a Dr. who is meticulous in their work.

Dr Bigley sat and spoke with me for an hour and 45 minutes, getting to know me as a whole person. I felt so comfortable with him that I was totally honest in a way in which I usually do not feel comfortable with other physicians. If you want a doctor that wants to actually help you, Dr Bigley is that person.

Dr. Lieberman is a very effective clinician and wonderful human being. He is able to look at the big picture and focus on the smaller details as well. It’s reassuring to have him communicate with specialists on my behalf. The messaging app used by the practice is extremely helpful tracking tests and filling the need for communication without going to the office.

As someone who hasn’t been to a regular physician in over fifteen years, I had the most amazing experience with Dr. David! Their office is incredibly welcoming and my visit was great! The office has lots of greenery and not your typical doctors space that can feel very un-inviting. 10 out of 10! And the prices are insanely affordable for lab work!

Just started seeing Dr. Lieberman. I was so happy that I found a Doctor who listens. He was so tuned in and prepared for my appointments. He is incredibly kind and compassionate. I am just coming off major open heart surgery, he has excellent knowledge not only the body but tremendous in nutrition. I could not be happier.

We are so grateful to have found this practice. As a newer family, we’ve felt incredibly welcomed and supported from the very beginning. Dr. Bigley has been amazing with our kids—patient, kind, and truly attentive during every visit. We feel very lucky to be under his care and would highly recommend him to any family looking for a compassionate and trustworthy doctor.

He spends a generous amount of time at appointments and is very thorough, we never feel rushed and leave with plenty of information. We love that we can reach out to him via text or the online portal and get same day feedback to our concerns. We see him for our 5 year old and newborn for our primary care. Highly recommend!!
